title: A plugin's output
description: The standard format: what every plugin finds, in the same fields, so one page can show any of them. A check or a script gives ok, reason, summary and items. The scheduler adds plugin, taken and took_ms, and error when the plugin itself went wrong.

taken.description: When it ran, in Unix seconds.

ok.description: False when there was nothing to read: see reason or error.

reason.description: Why there's nothing to read, when what it watches isn't there.

error.description: What went wrong, when the plugin itself broke.

summary.description: One line about all of it.

key.description: Never changes, so your name for it, and whether you hide or watch it, survive a restart.

original.description: Its own name on the system, when name is a plainer one. Shown small under it.

unit.description: What a number is counted in: %, ms, GB.

state.description: Leave it out when the item is only information.

note.description: A line or two in plain words.

section.description: A heading to gather items under.

facts.description: Details, shown when the item is opened.

items.description: Its parts, like a project's containers.
